environment: maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-21; pinned source; test harness only
scope: Seven actual defuse actions with controlled source/target leave/return/movement; casualty pre-loss and loss events including attached weapon; Electrobinoculars empty/nonempty Reserve action eligibility. Native grouped casualty events are normalized to per-card events for comparison.
officialRules: https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf (p21 implied target rule; p169 mining droids and duds)

differences.gemp: Card1_035 offers the action with empty Reserve.
differences.native: Rejects initiation under the explicit AR p21 prohibition on peeking into an empty pile. Paid actions already initiated still complete as far as possible.

limitations: Controlled defuse zone changes are fixture interventions, not a played removal/redeployment combo. GEMP physical-card target behavior is preserved; no universal target-instance policy is inferred.
Dud disposal/state validation and stale just-lost response protection have native tests and official rules support, not new equivalent GEMP traces.
Aboard targets, enclosed vehicles, other mines and generic loss prevention/replacement remain required. Full match admission stays closed.
